scripts.dev: pnpm supabase:start && pnpm stack:up && pnpm --filter web dev
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter web lint && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml run --rm backend ruff check .
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter web typecheck && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml run --rm backend mypy
scripts.format: prettier --write . && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml run --rm backend ruff format .
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml run --rm backend ruff format --check .
scripts.test: pnpm --filter web test && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml run --rm backend pytest
